description:
YouTube
==
- feat(YouTube - Hide feed components): Selectively hide carousel shelves from Home, Subscriptions, and Search results (Closes https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/3077)
- feat(YouTube - Spoof streaming data): Update innerTube client
- fix(YouTube - Video playback): `Disable playback speed for music` sometimes does not apply


YouTube Music
==
- feat(YouTube Music): Rename `Spoof player parameter` patch to `Fix playback` patch (Closes https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/3079)
- feat(YouTube Music - Disable Cairo Splash Animation): Move `Disable Cairo Splash Animation` from Miscellaneous to General (Closes https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/3049)
- feat(YouTube Music - Settings): Add patch option `Insert position` (Closes https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/3075)


Shared
==
- feat(GmsCore support): Add patch option `Disable Core Services` (Do not use it)


Announcement
==
- **There is a change in `options.json`. If you see warnings related to patch options, remove the `options.json` file or `Patch options`.**
- Compatible ReVanced Manager: [RVX Manager v1.23.5 (fork)](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-manager/releases/tag/v1.23.5).
